title: 江戸っ子の泣きどころ

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sheesh, what am I doin'? Can't believe I'd go and forget my bag. All right, all good now…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's that?! …Guess I imagined somethin'. Geez, that gave me a scare, though!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …There's nothin' there, right? Hold up… even if it was an evil spirit, there's no way the great Inari would be scared!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Waaah?! What the heck?! Get lost, ya fiend!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day, when I tell Inari One about the stray cat that snuck into my office, she looks at me with an unusually weary expression and nods.
